lots.guide_summary: All of it is SOLD at Gowans, with no UNSOLD or ASKING evidence. The two closest matches, both black faux-marble painted surrounds with turned drops, each sold for $5 hammer with no bids (Nov 2025). An arched surround of the same form, but stripped and polished, made $67. Polished cedar ($900) and Huon ($90, $230) surrounds sell on the timber and do not apply. All AUD, rate 1.0.
lots.working: The lowest close SOLD is $5 (lots 372666 and 374507, both inside 24 months). Keep: 5 / 1.198 = 4.17, rounded down to the nearest $5 gives $0. In practice this room pays about $5 for a painted faux-marble surround, so a bid of $5 to $10 gets it at the going rate. Flip: resale at Gowans would be about $5 to $25. Less 15% vendor commission (an assumed figure) and no postage (pickup), then / 2.396, gives under $10, which rounds to $0. Salvage-yard retail for period surrounds could be much higher, but none was seen, so it cannot support a bid.
lots.confidence_reason: The form and finish are clear in the photo, and two same-style SOLD results were checked through the API and their photos. There is no mark, and its age is unproven, so it is Medium, not High.
lots.dropped_entries: Dropped: 368034 CAST IRON FIRE SURROUND $45 and 433457 CAST IRON FIREPLACE SURROUND & 1 OTHER $170 (different material, multi-item lot); 410736 FIRE SURROUND WITH MIRROR $110 (has an overmantel mirror, not like for like); 383520 MANTLE PIECE $15 and 405473 BLACKWOOD MANTLE PIECE $5 (shelf only, not a surround). All the prices and dates the researcher claimed matched the API. Reclassified after viewing photos: 374507 raised to close; 394554 lowered to category guide.
lots.key_photo_findings: One photo. Complete surround: shelf, frieze, arched opening with painted spandrels, two turned drop finials, incised outlined panels on the legs, plinth blocks. The paint is worn on the shelf edge and the plinths. No marks are visible. It looks like softwood (likely pine) under original or old paint.
lots.condition: It looks complete and sound, with wear to the paint on the shelf and plinths. The back, any fixing damage, and borer are not visible.
lots.question_for_gowans: Please confirm the width and height, whether the back or legs have borer or rot, and whether the faux-marble paint is original.

lots.guide_summary: All of it is SOLD at Gowans in the last 6 months, with no UNSOLD or ASKING evidence. Wide, clean macrocarpa slabs like this made $50 to $115 hammer. The best match, lot 1418 from the same rack last week, made $115. Narrow or knotty slabs sell for $5 to $25. All AUD, rate 1.0, hammer only.
lots.working: Close SOLD results, all inside 24 months: $115, $85, $70, $65, $57 and $50. Keep: lowest $50 / 1.198 = 41.7, rounded down to $40. Flip: likely resale is about $70, the middle of the close results, kept below the $115 top. Less 15% vendor commission (an assumed figure for a Gowans resale, no postage since it is pickup) = $59.50, / 2.396 = 24.8, rounded down to $25. The flip margin is thin, so this is mainly a keep for a woodworker.
lots.confidence_reason: The chalked lot number and date were read. Several close SOLD results were checked through the API and their photos, including a near-identical slab from the same rack. Species and dimensions rest only on the catalogue and the photo, so it is Medium.
lots.dropped_entries: Dropped: the researcher's summary entry '117 lots, median $20' (an aggregate, not a single sale, and mostly narrow boards); the 'SLAB OF MACROCARPA PINE $35 to $80' group entry (a differently catalogued item, and an aggregate); MACROCARPA BENCH SEAT $100 and $145 (finished furniture, not a raw slab). Every individual price and bid count the researcher claimed matched the API. Note: lot 1418 ($115) is from the 9 Oct sale, not the current auction, so it stands.
lots.key_photo_findings: One photo, with the lot chalked '1399 16/10/26'. The widest and tallest board in the rack, about 2.2 m on its comparison with the wall rails. Pale, even grain with a few small tight knots and a live edge on one side. No splits are visible on the face. Thickness cannot be seen.
lots.condition: Raw, sawn slab, looks clean with few knots. Seasoning, moisture, thickness and end checks are unknown.
lots.question_for_gowans: Please give the length, width and thickness, and say whether it is air-dried or green and whether there are end splits.
